placements.why: This envelope's content — a standing cadence directive and an owner assignment — is organizational-governance grain: how the org disciplines itself operationally, not a product/architecture/opportunity claim. No strata exist yet for this repo, and this is the first content that names such a category, so it is minted standalone with no parent required.
placements.title: operational cadence and single-threaded ownership as the unit of organizational discipline
placements.frame: Does this content establish a recurring operational practice with a named accountable owner, the way organizations govern themselves rather than what they build?

placements.title: capability is real only once rehearsed, not merely designed or claimed
placements.frame: Does this expression treat an operational capability as proven and possessed only through rehearsed practice, rather than assumed from design or declaration?
placements.why: src-2 states the constitutive principle — an unrehearsed rollback is not actually possessed — and src-1/src-3/src-4 enact that principle operationally by fixing a monthly cadence and naming a single accountable owner. Together these name a subject (rehearsal as the proof of capability, sustained by recurring cadence and ownership) that future envelopes about other drills, cadences, or capability claims will keep feeding, not a one-time fact. No existing narrative leaf or strata exactly or closely covers this theme, so it is minted fresh under the newly minted Organization strata rather than left standalone, since it is clearly an organizational-cadence theme rather than a foundational orphan.
